21. In any event, Victory Fire submits that even FSD’s officers have different understanding of the shut down notification requirements, RFSICS instruct Victory Fire are not to be taken as having different understanding of the notification requirements with Mr. Keung.

C3. Comparing to the Reform introduced by FSD

22. Apart from looking at the requirements under FSD Circular Letter No.1/2021 and the SDN template, Victory Fire’s interpretation on its duties under the existing regulatory framework at the time of the fire is also reflected from the reforms introduced by FSD after the fire at Wang Fuk Court.

23. FSD has new medium-term measures for FSD to proactively conduct inspections and functional tests of FSIs in about 1,500 residential buildings constructed on or before 1 March 1987 where any notification of defective or out of order FAS and/or the hydrant hose reel system from the RFSICS has been received, to verify the operational status of the FAS [W/S/154/8][6].

24. One of the aims is to check if another FAS would be affected if one system was shut down [TF/244-2026/40;31-36].

“消防署大作解：因為要證明臨近系統口供第 16 段，其中其中一個系統停工會否影響另一個系統，消防署於中一間情況說明有大一消防系統內八座一個 SDN，屬同一個消防系統，跟住消防署去大一個系統停工，睇另一個系統會否受影響，會睇個警鐘同埋個系統發生，而家個新架構係都係會睇咁。”
